title: Generating and storing the chunk embeddings

videos.script: A chunk of sixty words says a book, and fourteen days. It never says which policy it belongs to. {{bare}} Put its heading path in front before embedding it, and the search finds every answer in the test set. {{path}} Then the vectors go to the provider, thirty-two at a time. When a request fails, the SDK waits and tries again, longer each time, and gives up only when its budget runs out. {{retry}} Every chunk becomes a row, with its document, its status, its audience and its owner beside the vector. {{table}} Its id is a hash of its text. Change one sentence of the policy, and one chunk is embedded again. The other hundred and thirty-six are left alone. {{ids}} Mark a document superseded, and nothing is embedded at all. Delete it, and its chunks leave in the same run. {{delete}} Last, a check that fails loudly when the index is not what it should be. {{check}} From the next lesson on, this table is what every search reads. {{end}}
